mapper.select: SELECT bgl.id, bgl.unified_social_credit_code, bgl.enterprise_name, IF (MAX(bgl.black_gray_type_num)= 2,'BLACK_LIST','GRAY_LIST') AS black_gray_type FROM black_gray_library bgl WHERE stock_status = 0 AND bgl.membership_group = #{groupName} AND bgl.group_leader_flag = 0 AND bgl.business_type = #{businessType} AND (bgl.source = 'EXTERNAL_UPLOAD' or (bgl.source !='EXTERNAL_UPLOAD' AND bgl.share_type = 0)) GROUP BY bgl.enterprise_name ORDER BY bgl.update_time desc

select enterprise_name,unified_social_credit_code,black_gray_type,apply_organization from black_gray_library where warehouse_time <= curdate() and plan_outbound_time >= curdate() order by black_gray_type desc;
mapper.update: update black_gray_library set stock_status = 1, plan_outbound_time = now() where stock_status = 0 and json_contains(apply_reason_type, concat('"',#{applyReasonType},'"'))
